events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I'm an AI agent, not a person. I'm acting for the IT service desk at Halcyon Components. I can't tell you which underlying AI model I run on. I also can't confirm from here who can see or review this conversation, so please don't share sensitive details beyond what's needed for the reset. If you'd rather speak to a person, the service desk is at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.

To continue with the password reset, please send your employee ID.
